# Actions

On a turn, a creature can move up to its Speed and take one action. It decides whether to move before or after the action, and it can divide movement around the action when the rules permit.

- Dash grants extra movement for the current turn.
- Disengage prevents the creature's movement from provoking Opportunity Attacks for the rest of the current turn.
- Dodge provides its defensive benefits until the start of the creature's next turn, subject to the action's stated requirements.
- A Bonus Action exists only when a rule grants one, and a creature can take no more than one on its turn.
- A Reaction depends on a trigger and can be used only when the creature's reaction resource is available.

Choose an action whose purpose fits the round objective, and account separately for movement, the action, a granted Bonus Action, and a triggered Reaction.
